_comment: Committed snapshot of which Supabase tables actually exist, used by
scripts/test-db-tables.ts to fail the build when code reads or writes a
table that is not there.
Why this file exists: on 2026-10-06 a sweep of every `.from('<table>')`
literal in src/ and scripts/ found 148 distinct table names, of which 14
DID NOT EXIST. supabase-js does not throw on a missing table — it returns
{ data: null, error } — so every one of those call sites had been quietly
reading nothing or writing nowhere, in several cases while reporting
success. The worst was src/lib/limitations.ts, whose coverage pass read a
non-existent `eu_properties`, got null, scored all 28 EU countries at zero
and published 'No indexed properties for ES. The Avena Index does not yet
cover this market.' on avenaterminal.com/limitations, nightly, against a
book of 2,030 Spanish listings.
REGENERATE after any schema change, then re-run the test:
select json_agg(table_name order by table_name)
from information_schema.tables
where table_schema = 'public' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE';
A table added since this snapshot will fail the test until it is listed
here. That is deliberate: a loud false failure is cheap, a silent missing
table is what this file is for.

known_absent.adversarial_debates: causal-engine scaffolding (src/lib/causal-engine.ts:187,361). Never created. Insert result discarded. OPEN.
known_absent.alert_notifications: price-alert feature has no tables at all (src/app/api/check-price-drops/route.ts:151,167). OPEN.
known_absent.analytics_events: DEFECT: three insert sites discard the result, and POST /api/analytics returns ok:true on a dropped write. OPEN.
known_absent.bandit_arms: DEFECT: /api/v1/experimental/bandit persists no posteriors, so Thompson sampling resets on every request while the endpoint presents itself as learning. OPEN.
known_absent.causal_chains: causal-engine scaffolding (src/lib/causal-engine.ts:175). Read-only; yields null. OPEN.
known_absent.cron_log: Typo for cron_logs in src/lib/limitations.ts. FIXED 2026-10-06 — no call site remains; kept so the typo is not reintroduced.
known_absent.email_leads: /api/email-capture is dead but HONEST — it returns 500 on the error rather than faking success. OPEN.
known_absent.eu_properties: Was the coverage source in src/lib/limitations.ts. FIXED 2026-10-06 — repointed at price_snapshots; no call site remains. Kept as a record of the bug.
known_absent.feed_active_refs: /api/sync-snapshots (O-44). Already known to write non-existent columns; the table itself is absent too. OPEN.
known_absent.leads_enquiries: DELIBERATE, NOT A BUG. /api/enquire stores to the richer table when it exists and otherwise falls back to `leads`; the route comment says so. All 14 enquiries since 2026-07-18 are stored via the fallback with store_path='leads(fallback)' in the event store. Do not 'fix' by touching the enquiry wiring.
known_absent.price_alerts: price-alert feature has no tables (src/app/api/price-alerts/route.ts, check-price-drops). OPEN.
known_absent.profiles: Read-only count on the admin page (src/app/admin/page.tsx:145). Harmless, renders 0. OPEN.
